name: scientific-agent-skills
description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 175,000+ scientists worldwide. 163 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
one_liner: Gives an AI assistant hundreds of ready-made science skills and databases so it can do real biology, chemistry, and drug-discovery research work.
buyer: A biotech founder or small lab director who can't afford a full bioinformatics team but needs research done now.
business_use_cases: A two-person biotech startup runs drug-target literature searches and pathway analysis without hiring a bioinformatician.
A university lab automates routine chemistry-database lookups and paper screening for grad students.
A contract research organization offers cheaper preliminary research reports by having an agent run the standard workflows first.

money_ideas.idea: Run a consulting service that executes these skills against a small biotech client's open questions and delivers a report.
Offer a managed, hosted version with curated databases and support for labs that don't want to self-host.

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AI research assistant for hire' service to small biotech labs, running these skills against their open questions this week.
